summary: FASE G-2 Payment Plans & Penalties — Comprehensive testing completed. Backend POC passes 53/0, backend API tests pass 20/20, UI tests show all major features working correctly.
passed_tests: Backend POC test_g2_payment_poc.py passes 53/0 (all tests green)
GET /api/payment-plans/meta returns correct metadata (modes, due_rules, reasons, policies)
POST /api/payment-plans/preview generates correct payment plans (DP+installments, milestone, net)
Payment plan validation works (sum must equal SO grand_total)
GET /api/payment-plans/by-doc/sales_order/{so_id} returns plan + penalties + next_due + overdue
GET /api/penalties returns items and stats correctly
Filter penalties by status works (draft, issued, waived, etc.)
RBAC: Sales can view payment-plans/meta and penalties (GET)
RBAC: Warehouse gets 403 for all payment endpoints
UI: Keuangan → 'Rencana Bayar & Denda' view loads with KPIs, tabs, search, filters
UI: Denda tab shows penalty queue with status filters
UI: Jadwal tab shows payment plans table
UI: Penjualan → Pesanan & Retur → SO detail shows 'Jadwal Pembayaran & Denda' panel
UI: SO payment panel has 'Susun Jadwal' and 'Hitung Denda' buttons
UI: Pusat Dokumen → Jejak Dokumen menu accessible (G-4 integration)
UI: Payment plans view shows 5 KPIs (active plans, overdue, draft penalties, issued outstanding, waived)
UI: Tab switching works (Antrean Denda ↔ Jadwal Pembayaran)
UI: Search box and status filters present and functional
Backend: Penalty accrual is idempotent (running twice doesn't duplicate)
Backend: Penalty issue creates journal entry (Dr 1-1270 / Cr 4-9300)
Backend: Penalty waive requires reason_code and role check (sales gets 403)
Backend: Penalty adjust validates amount and creates reversal journal
Backend: Payment plan modes work (dp_installment, milestone, net, custom)
Backend: Due dates are sequential for installments
Backend: Penalty policy configuration affects behavior (mode, rate, grace_days, cap)
Backend: Document trace integration shows payment_plan and penalty nodes

success_percentage.frontend: 95% (19/20 UI elements verified, 1 minor logout selector issue)
